fields.text: Any touch greater than a feather triggers the ceiling in 24 CRUSH HALLWAY. It takes 10 seconds to fall 10', rests for 10 seconds, then resets.
fields.title: Crush Hallway Ceiling Cycle

fields.text: Each of the three disguised spring trap doors in 24 CRUSH HALLWAY drops a victim 40' to the water below.
fields.title: Crush Hallway Trap-Door Fall

fields.text: If the oil covering the water in 24C is ignited, it burns for 5 minutes.
fields.title: 24C Oil Layer Burns

contents: Crushed furniture debris on the east side.

discoverable.condition: Tap the floor to listen for hollow sections.
discoverable.information: Three perfectly disguised trap doors sound hollow.

fields.first_impression: A 90' hallway has thick splinters and wood shards spread around its east side.
hazards: The ceiling falls 10' in 10 seconds, rests for 10 seconds, then resets.
Three disguised spring trap doors drop victims 40' to water below.
hidden: Any contact heavier than a feather triggers the descending ceiling.
Each disguised trap door is driven by a hinge and strong spring.
fields.title: 24 CRUSH HALLWAY
triggers: Entering the hallway or applying more than feather-light contact starts the ceiling's lowering cycle.

contents: A floating broken chair missing two legs.
fields.first_impression: A chamber of water 10' deep contains a broken chair missing two legs.
fields.title: 24A

contents: A rusted-shut portcullis permitting sight but not access into 42 SUNKEN GALLERY.
fields.first_impression: Water 10' deep lies before a rusted-shut portcullis through which 42 SUNKEN GALLERY can be seen but not entered.
fields.title: 24B

discoverable.condition: Search the bottom of the 10'-deep water.
discoverable.information: Two flasks of oil and broken glass lie on the bottom.

fields.first_impression: Water 10' deep is covered by a layer of oil.
hazards: The surface oil burns for 5 minutes if ignited.
resources: Two flasks of oil on the bottom.
fields.title: 24C

steps: A human can sprint across before the ceiling crushes without a Movement check, but Movement checks are required to jump the three disguised trap doors unless those doors are disabled.
Alternatively, throw an uncrushable object such as the metal cage, ballista, or a combination of sturdy objects into the hallway; those objects are not recoverable.
Alternatively, climb along the wall with iron spikes and ropes; this takes about an hour and causes a couple of encounter checks.
Alternatively, disable the trap doors from 22 MUSHROOM and then sprint across.
fields.title: Cross 24 CRUSH HALLWAY
fields.trigger: The party attempts to traverse the 90' crushing hallway.

activation.condition: Any touch greater than a feather in the hallway triggers the ceiling; stepping on a trap door triggers that floor panel.

outcomes: A human can sprint the length without a Movement check for the ceiling.
Movement checks are needed to jump the three trap doors unless disabled.
The ceiling takes 10 seconds to fall 10', rests for 10 seconds, then resets.
fields.perceived: After someone enters the 90' hall, the ceiling begins descending toward the floor; hidden floor panels can spring open beneath runners.

repeat.condition: The ceiling falls, rests, and resets; trap doors remain active unless their remote switches are held.

stakes: Entrants can be crushed by the ceiling.
Runners can fall 40' through one of three disguised trap doors into the water chambers.
fields.title: 24 CRUSH HALLWAY Trap
